content.text: Are you ready to step into the future of AI and ML? This is a question that many professionals are asking themselves today as organisations are actively restructuring their DNA with AI. Today, this technology is at the forefront of change and driving a technological renaissance, redefining how humanity approaches its greatest challenges. Organisations are either hiring experts in the domain or are pushing their employees to upskill because the AI of today already has the capability to:Slash redundant effort across processesOffer complex solutions tailored to specific business needsHelp multiply employee productivityEven execute processes end-to-end without any manual interventionBelieve it or not, organisations are aware that they need to pivot towards higher AI-consciousness to stay competitive. US-Israel-Iran War News Live Updates: Iran vows tit-for-tat strike after Trump's 48hr ultimatum, threatens to hit US-Israel energy facilityIf America strikes us, we should attack Indian cities like Delhi and Mumbai: Ex-Pak envoyTrump Pauses Planned Strikes: US halts Iran attack plan for 5 days; talks called very good and productiveAs NASSCOM and BCG forecast, India's AI market is on a meteoric rise, expected to reach $17 billion by 2027, becoming a key driver of economic growth and innovation.1But, India still faces a 51% demand-supply gap in AI and ML professionals, with a demand of over 629,000 specialists but a supply of only 416,000.2 This gap presents a tremendous opportunity with 10x more projected jobs and 4x more higher salaries available to those who upskill in AI and ML.Recognising this demand, Emeritus and IITM Pravartak (the technological hub of IIT Madras) have launched the Professional Certificate Programme in AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning.This programme is tailored for professionals eager to leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive innovation and tackle complex problems. This unique programme offers participants a competitive edge in the industry, featuring rigorous instruction from distinguished IIT faculty and globally renowned AI and ML experts. The faculty lineup includes Professor C. Chandra Sekhar, former Head of the CSE Department at IIT Madras (2019–22), and Professor Dileep A.D., Professor at IIT Dharwad and a research scholar at IIT Madras. These award-winning educators have published numerous research papers in prestigious international journals, making them ideal mentors for this transformative journey. The programme further combines IIT faculty teachings with live sessions led by domain experts, delving into real-world applications and tools. Participants will also engage in hands-on labs designed to cultivate practical expertise, ensuring that they graduate as well-rounded AI and ML professionals ready to meet the demands of this rapidly growing field.Programme highlights: Transform your AI and ML Journey with IITM PravartakThe Professional Certificate Programme in AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning is thoughtfully designed to combine academic brilliance, industry insights, and hands-on learning to prepare you for a thriving career in the AI and ML domain. With distinguished IIT faculty, a practical curriculum, and global certifications, this programme ensures a seamless blend of theoretical understanding and practical application. Here’s what makes it stand out:Comprehensive curriculum backed by domain expertsWith access to 25+ tools and Gen AI libraries taught in cutting-edge virtual integrated labs, and a curriculum designed for real-world application, the programme ensures you gain practical, job-ready skills. Weekly live sessions by domain experts further enhance your learning with insights into the latest tools and practices.Prestigious Certifications from IITM Pravartak and IBMStand out with a certification from IITM Pravartak. These globally respected credentials not only validate your expertise but also significantly enhance your professional credibility. The programme also offers three IBM Certifications and access to IBM masterclasses led by industry leaders. Focus areas include:• Deep Learning with TensorFlow• Building Your Own Chatbot• PyTorch: Tensor, Dataset, and Data AugmentationAffordable and high-value educationCombining premium instruction with cost-effectiveness, this programme provides a long-term return on investment. With up to 4x higher earning potential, the affordability of this course makes it accessible for learners aiming to gain cutting-edge AI and ML skills without breaking the bank.A flexible and engaging learning experienceLearn at your own pace with pre-recorded videos designed for flexibility while engaging with interactive live sessions. This blended learning approach ensures you gain deep knowledge while balancing work and personal commitments.Real-world applications through projects and casesGet hands-on experience solving over 30 real-world projects and cases and participate in a two-week capstone project to showcase your expertise in practical applications of AI and ML.Exclusive Agentic AI masterclasses for advanced learning Learn about agent lifecycle, different strategies, core components, and tools using which you can build and deploy your own intelligent agents that can execute real-world tasks. Go through different case studies, learn about responsible AI, and map out future trends.Build your digital brand on GitHub and collaborate on KaggleStrengthen your professional presence by creating a robust portfolio on platforms like GitHub and Kaggle, demonstrating your skills and projects to potential employers.Optional immersion at IIT Madras Research ParkEngage with the innovative ecosystem of IITM Pravartakthrough an optional two-day campus immersion at the IIT Madras Research Park. Interact with faculty, explore cutting-edge research, and experience a world-class technological hub.Career advancement with Emeritus supportLeverage Emeritus’ career services, including placement assistance, resume-building workshops, and industry connections, to unlock unparalleled career opportunities in the AI and ML domain.Who will benefit from this programme? The Professional Certificate Programme in AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning is thoughtfully designed to cater to a diverse range of professionals. Whether you are a technical expert eager to advance your skills or a business leader striving to understand the transformative power of AI, this programme equips you with the knowledge and tools to excel in the rapidly evolving world of AI and ML.With its blend of theoretical depth and practical insights, this programme is perfect for:• Data Scientists and Data Analysts Elevate your career by mastering cutting-edge AI and ML techniques. This programme helps you refine your expertise in tools and methodologies that power advanced analytics and predictive modeling.• Software Engineers: Whether transitioning into AI/ML roles or integrating AI capabilities into existing projects, software professionals will gain a robust foundation in machine learning algorithms and real-world applications.• Business Analysts and Consultants: Move beyond conventional analysis—learn to harness AI to drive strategic, data-backed decision-making, enabling smarter recommendations and improved outcomes for clients and stakeholders.• Product Managers and Product Owners: Expand your toolkit by integrating AI and ML into product development. Understand how to design, develop, and manage AI-driven solutions that meet user needs and boost product performance.By the end of this programme, here’s what you’ll be equipped to do:1. Lead AI/ML InitiativesTake charge of AI and ML projects from concept to execution. You'll be equipped to drive innovation and solve complex business challenges by applying AI techniques to real-world problems, delivering actionable solutions that accelerate growth and transformation.2. Make Data-Driven DecisionsGain the ability to extract valuable insights from vast datasets. Whether in operations, marketing, or strategy, you’ll learn to leverage AI to make informed, data-driven decisions that improve business outcomes and optimise performance.3. Collaborate with AI/ML TeamsBecome proficient in speaking the language of data scientists and engineers. By bridging the gap between business and technical teams, you’ll be able to effectively communicate requirements, align objectives, and execute AI initiatives seamlessly.4. Stay Ahead of the CurveThe AI and ML landscape is constantly evolving. With this programme, you’ll stay updated on the latest advancements and emerging trends, ensuring that you are always at the forefront of the industry and prepared to implement cutting-edge technologies.Programme details: Key information at a glance• Programme Start Date: 31st March 2026• Duration: 10 Months• Weekly Commitment: 9-10 hours/week (additional effort may be required for non-technical students)• Programme Fee: ₹1,30,000 + GST• Format: Online, live interactive sessions(Enrol today to get an early bird discount of ₹12,000)As the technological landscape rapidly evolves, AI and ML are driving innovation across industries. By enrolling in this programme from IITM Pravartak, you are setting yourself up for success in one of the most dynamic and high-demand fields.With guidance from IIT's esteemed faculty, hands-on training with the latest tools, and the opportunity to earn industry-recognised certifications, you’ll be equipped to lead AI/ML initiatives, make data-driven decisions, and collaborate effectively with technical teams. If you are looking to gain a competitive edge in the AI and ML market and future-proof your career, this is your opportunity to get started.
